data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 and 2016 years of account have seen positive claims experience and the RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves. The 2015 underwriting year was closed at year end by means of a reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction and all liabilities transferred to a third party syndicate. The RITC yielded a profit for the Syndicate of GBP 49m as the premium was below the booked reserves. At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate held a members' balance relating to the 2015 underwriting year of GBP 13,256k, owing to the Members.

prior_year_events.impact_description: RITC produced a profit for the Syndicate as the RITC premium was below booked reserves, resulting in a release of prior year reserves
Revision to unallocated loss adjustment expenses calculation produced an overall release of ULAE, including a release allocated to 2015 and prior years
Change in estimated profit commission recognition produced a release of profit commission payable on 2014 and prior years

named_events.loss_description: Reserves established in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (Gross: GBP 74,828k, Net: GBP 23,040k)
Reserves established in respect of Californian wildfires (Gross: GBP 7,970k, Net: GBP 7,362k)

data.standardized_narrative: Prior-year reserves experienced a material release in 2017 driven by favourable claims development on the 2015 and 2016 years, the reinsurance-to-close (RITC) of the 2015 year which produced a GBP 49.0m profit (premium below booked reserves), and methodological adjustments (ULAE recalibration and profit commission recognition) that released further amounts. These drivers, together with portfolio re-underwriting and year-of-account settlements, resulted in an overall prior-year release (net effect reflected in the underwriting year breakdown) equivalent to approximately GBP 84.9m.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement (PYD) was not given as a single explicit gross figure. I used the year-of-account underwriting-result breakdown (sum of non-current-year underwriting results) as a primary indicator of prior-year release (-GBP 84.907m). The claims development triangle is present and gross; it was OCRed with some row/column alignment ambiguity - I included the triangle under _claims_triangle but did not compute PYD from it due to alignment uncertainty. Some smaller releases (ULAE GBP 10.727k and profit commission GBP 4.6k) and the RITC profit (GBP 49m) are explicitly stated and were included in the narrative and prior_year_events. Where I computed LOB-level movements I used the claims concentration table (gross liabilities by LOB) comparing 2016 vs 2017; these are changes in gross outstanding claims by LOB (high confidence).
